payload.summary: Product decision (visualjc, chat 2026-08-17, transcribed by agent): item references become slug-or-id across every command, matching the roadmap layer; an ambiguous slug refuses and lists candidates rather than guessing; item names stay non-unique; ids remain the only thing stored. Charted as roadmap node h44hc0j5 (item-refs-by-slug) at horizon next. Trigger was a bare id (2xtxgmqy) being meaningless to a human moving between agents and projects. Carries a required CONTEXT.md amendment — the glossary currently states references always use the id, never the slug — which needs the maintainer's own sign-off.
